standard_prerequisites.name: Simplicial objects and their chain complexes
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a simplicial object U of an additive category, the associated chain complexes s(U) and, over an abelian category, the normalised complex N(U), together with the definition of homotopy of morphisms of simplicial objects and of chain complexes.
standard_prerequisites.use: They are the objects of the statement (source lines 5035-5039).

standard_prerequisites.name: Homotopy is an equivalence relation
standard_prerequisites.statement: Being homotopic is an equivalence relation on the set of maps of chain complexes (Homology, Section homology-section-complexes, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It allows a chain of elementary homotopies to be shortened to one (source lines 5046-5054).

standard_prerequisites.name: Decomposition of N in terms of s
standard_prerequisites.statement: N(a) and N(b) factor as compositions N(U) to s(U) to s(V) to N(V) with s(a), s(b) in the middle (the author's lemma-decompose-associated-complexes, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It reduces the statement for N to the statement for s (source lines 5057-5063).

standard_prerequisites.name: Composition of homotopies
standard_prerequisites.statement: A composite of maps with one factor already known to be homotopic to another is homotopic accordingly (Homology, Lemma homology-lemma-compose-homotopy, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It finishes the proof for N (source lines 5063-5065).

core_obligations: Chain the elementary homotopies: write a as a_0, ..., a_n = b with each consecutive pair homotopic in one direction, use the preceding calculation to get the corresponding chain for s, and shorten it using that being homotopic is an equivalence relation (source lines 5042-5054).
Reduce N to s: factor N(a) and N(b) through s(a) and s(b) using the decomposition lemma (source lines 5056-5063).
Conclude with the composition lemma for homotopies (source lines 5063-5065).

proof_roadmap.step: Pass from a homotopy between a and b to a chain of elementary homotopies and conclude the statement for s.
Factor N(a) and N(b) through s(a) and s(b) using the decomposition lemma.
Apply the composition lemma for homotopies to finish.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-homotopy-s-N at source lines 5033-5040: for an additive category and homotopic morphisms a, b : U to V of simplicial objects, the induced maps s(a), s(b) on the associated chain complexes are homotopic, and over an abelian category the same holds for N(a), N(b). The proof at source lines 5042-5066 chains the homotopy along a sequence of elementary homotopies (using that being homotopic is an equivalence relation on maps of chain complexes), which gives the statement for s, and then factors N(a) and N(b) through s(a) and s(b) using the author's decomposition lemma and concludes with the Homology chapter's composition lemma. It is short; the substance is the two reductions, and the second one depends on the sign conventions built into the decomposition of N in terms of s.
